messages:
prod-monitor: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary group 'checkout-v2' error rate spike > 15% across eu-west-1 and us-west-2 at 12:07 UTC. Auto-rollout paused.
incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-5412. Pager to oncall_joe and sre_lee.
oncall_joe: looking. grabbing logs from canary servers now. any immediate customer tickets?
support_maya: a couple of merchants reported checkout failures, small subset (~0.6% of traffic) but consistent. forwarding sample request IDs.
sre_lee: seeing inter-region fallback churn in the router logs — many requests from eu-west-1 are being routed to us-west-2 then bounced back. TTL for sticky route looks low but sticky affinity still reassigning variants.
eng_runtime_ana: ok paste of relevant snippet: ```router: route_request(req){ if(canary && fallback_policy==sticky){ assign_variant(canary); } else assign_variant(stable); }``` Not ideal. Can share full trace.
oncall_joe: any sign of wrong model variant? canary should have variant v2-q8, but some nodes report v2-fp16.
eng_runtime_ana: confirmed — model manifest mismatch on 2/8 canary hosts: they pulled v2-fp16 (stable) instead of v2-q8. rollout agent logged successful pull but checksum mismatch ignored due to retry logic.
pm_jordan: that explains output differences. Did we enable automatic fallback to stable? that could cause sticky session flip flopping.
sre_lee: yes fallback policy=sticky with affinity TTL=30s. When a canary node returns error, router falls back to stable and sticks the session. But when that stable node later drops due to capacity, it reverts, causing routing oscillation.
oncall_joe: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (already paused). 2) force all canary traffic to stable variant cluster (manual sticky override) 3) fix canary nodes manifest and restart agent. 4) increase affinity TTL temporarily to avoid oscillation during restart. any objections?
eng_runtime_ana: +1. However manual sticky override syntax? we can set route policy for route 'checkout' to "force_variant=stable" for canary group id, will take effect immediately.
support_maya: go ahead, prefer forced stable while we notify affected customers.
incident-bot: Action taken: rollout paused by oncall_joe at 12:12 UTC.
oncall_joe: performing force_variant now: ```curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/policies/checkout -d '{"force_variant":"stable","scope":"canary-group:checkout-v2"}' -H 'Authorization: token'```
eng_runtime_ana: policy applied. router logs show new decision: assigned stable for 100% canary sessions. error rate dropping in eu-west-1.
sre_lee: increasing affinity TTL to 300s to dampen oscillation. ```PATCH /controlplane/policies/checkout {"affinity_ttl":300}```
pm_jordan: customer comms: initial banner drafted, sending to legal for review.
support_maya: tickets: updating affected merchant list and marking as mitigated with "temporary routing to stable variant".
oncall_joe: ok next: repair canary nodes. I'm kicking off config-redeploy to 2 hosts at a time to avoid capacity shock. expect 8-10 min per host. monitoring logs for successful checksum.
eng_runtime_ana: note: agent code had a de-dupe bug where checksum mismatch at pull-time logged but didn't fail deployment. creating patch PR now and will hotfix after canary is healthy.
sre_lee: watch for residual sticky entries. running job to evict stale affinities for checkout route to clear any bad pins.```adminctl evict-affinities --route checkout --older-than 15s```
oncall_joe: handing off to sre_lee for night watch. I'll remain reachable. oncall_joe signs off to secondary. :wave:
sre_lee: ack, monitoring dashboards, will escalate if error rate >5% or latency spikes.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated (routing override applied), pager cleared for oncall_joe at 12:34 UTC.
pm_jordan: postmortem owner? assigning eng_runtime_ana for root cause and remediation. deliverable: bugfix PR + test for checksum enforcement, rollout-safety check added to control plane.
eng_runtime_ana: acknowledged, will put up RFC and PR by EOD.
support_maya: final note: small percentage of merchants saw failed payment attempts and retries; will coordinate refunds where needed.
sre_lee: closing checklist: confirm canary hosts all have correct variant and agent fix deployed, revert force_variant and restore affinity_ttl to 30s after stable behavior for 24h.
oncall_joe: last check: error rate back to baseline ~0.5% and routing churn dropped. handing final status to incident-bot to close.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-5412 marked resolved at 12:42 UTC.
